data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 379.4m. Using the published gross claims development triangle, prior-year development for underwriting years up to and including 2019 shows an aggregate favourable movement (release) of approximately GBP 24.0m (around 6.3% of opening gross claims). The report attributes an improvement in the closed 2019 year and prior years' result, and the triangle indicates releases across multiple older years reflecting favourable claims development rather than a material change to reserve methodology.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (EUR 24.0m release) was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (page 101) by comparing each underwriting year's current estimate to the previous diagonal and summing for years up to 2019. There is some inconsistency in gross written premium figures across narrative and tables; Chairman's statement cites GBP 380m for 2021 which is used above. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was found; triangle-based calculation used as best estimate. Gross premium mix by regulatory class for 2021 was not unambiguously extractable from the provided pages.
